#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> arr(n), val(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> arr[i];
        val[i] = (arr[i] % 2 == 0) ? -1 : 1;
    }
    int sum = 0;
    vector<int> cost;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        sum += val[i];
        if (sum == 0) {
            cost.push_back(abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]));
        }
    }
    sort(cost.begin(), cost.end());
    int tcost = 0, maxp = 0;
    for (int c : cost) {
        if (tcost + c <= b) {
            tcost += c;
            maxp++;
        }
    }
    cout << maxp << endl;
    return 0;
}
